reason: I'd forward the free 30 receipts to see if it works, but my clients all together send way more than 100 documents a month, so realistically I'm looking at $35 or $79 out of my own pocket. I bill by the hour, so saving time doesn't pay me unless I get more clients, and those only come when the registration agents send them.
objection: Who pays, me or the client? My clients won't accept a higher fee for an app, and $35 to $79 a month is a big piece of what I earn.
would_change_my_mind: A way to pass the cost to each client, like a small plan per client they pay themselves, or a cheap bookkeeper plan for around $10 a month covering all my clients.
